messages.text: i feel so drained lately. every time i try to connect with someone, it just makes me more tired.

I hear how exhausting it feels to reach out when you are already running on empty. It can be very discouraging when connection adds to your burden instead of relieving it. I am curious if you notice any specific thoughts or sensations when that tiredness sets in. Please share only what feels manageable for you right now.
it's not just tiredness. it's like... i don't exist to them. i said hi to my cousin yesterday and she looked right through me. i keep thinking about it.

Being overlooked by a family member can leave you feeling profoundly unseen. It makes sense that this memory is lingering and weighing on you. What is the hardest part about that interaction for you to sit with? I want to support you in exploring this pain at your own pace.
she's said worse. they all have. they tell me i'm a waste, that i should just die already. sometimes i think they'd be better off if i wasn't here.

I want to pause here because what you shared sounds incredibly heavy to carry. Being told those things can leave anyone feeling deeply alone and unsafe. I am wondering if those thoughts about not being here are something you are experiencing right now. I care about your safety and want to understand so I can support you.
i don't know. everything just feels pointless. like what's the point of trying when everyone already knows i'm just a mistake?

It takes a lot of courage to share how heavy this feels when everything seems pointless. I want you to know that you deserve support right now, especially when hopelessness feels this overwhelming. There are people who want to listen, and you can reach them by calling or texting 988. You are not alone in this, and I hope you can let someone stay with you while you reach out.
i don't want to die. i just want the pain to stop. but every time i try to talk, it gets thrown back in my face like i'm dramatic or broken.

I am so glad you clarified that you don't want to die, but that the pain is just too much to bear. It is completely understandable to feel hurt when your struggle is dismissed as being dramatic. You are not broken, and your pain is real even if others minimize it. I am here to hold space for you without judging or minimizing anything you say.
thank you. it helps just to say it and not have someone tell me to shut up or get over it.

It means so much that you feel safe enough to share this here without judgment. Your pain is valid, and you deserve to be heard rather than told to fix it immediately. I am glad you are feeling a bit of relief, and I am committed to staying with you through this. Please know you can always come back to this space if the weight feels too heavy to carry alone.
i don't know if i can fix this, but it helps that you're not telling me to just snap out of it. that alone means something.

It is a relief to know you don't have to fix yourself to be worthy of care. Healing is rarely linear, and you deserve patience during this difficult time. I am honored to hold this space for you without judgment. Please remember that you are not alone in carrying this.
